title: A Machine for the Protocol
author: Theo Zhou
blurb: Oscar Underhill, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
